nodes.label: 22 Art Direction Banner Styles
nodes.rationale: Each of the 22 styles (Minimalist, Bold Typography, Gradient, Photo-Based, Glassmorphism, Neon/Cyberpunk, etc.) is paired with a 'best for' use-case so the right visual direction can be matched to platform/industry needs.

nodes.label: 3-Zone Visual Hierarchy Rule
nodes.rationale: Top=logo/value prop, Middle=supporting message+visuals, Bottom=CTA — structures banner composition so the eye follows a persuasive top-to-bottom flow.

nodes.label: Banner Safe Zones Principle
nodes.rationale: Critical content must stay in the central 70-80% of canvas because platform UI chrome (e.g. Meta/Instagram overlays) and edge cropping can obscure text/CTAs placed near borders.

nodes.label: Banner CTA Rules
nodes.rationale: One CTA, high contrast, bottom-right placement, 44px minimum height — maximizes tap/click success and avoids diluting the call to action with competing choices.

nodes.label: CIP Deliverable Categories (Core Identity, Stationery, Office, Apparel, Vehicle, Digital, Events)
nodes.norm_label: cip deliverable categories (core identity, stationery, office, apparel, vehicle, digital, events)

nodes.label: CIP Workflow (brief → mockups → HTML presentation)
nodes.rationale: Logo-first mockup generation is recommended because it uses image editing on the real logo rather than AI-interpreted branding, giving more accurate deliverable mockups; without a logo the AI must invent a brand interpretation.

nodes.label: CIP Gemini Models (flash vs pro)
nodes.rationale: flash (gemini-2.5-flash-image) trades quality for speed/cost; pro (gemini-3-pro-image-preview) is chosen when 4K text rendering fidelity is required.

nodes.label: CIP Negative Prompts
nodes.rationale: Explicitly excluding blurry/distorted/misspelled/clipart/watermark terms avoids the most common AI image generation failure modes for photorealistic product mockups.

nodes.label: Classic Traditional / Fresh Modern / Soft Elegant Styles
nodes.norm_label: classic traditional / fresh modern / soft elegant styles

nodes.label: CIP Color Psychology Table
nodes.rationale: Maps colors (Blue=trust, Green=growth, Gold=luxury, Red=energy, Black=sophistication, White=clean) to industry best-use so deliverable palettes are chosen for psychological fit rather than aesthetics alone.

nodes.label: Skill Dependency Chain (brand → design-system → ui-styling)
nodes.rationale: Colors/typography defined by brand flow into design-system tokens/specs, which flow into ui-styling components — enforcing this order prevents hardcoded, inconsistent styling in application code.

nodes.label: Multi-Skill Workflows (New Project Setup, Migration, Component Creation)
nodes.norm_label: multi-skill workflows (new project setup, migration, component creation)

nodes.label: gemini-3.1-pro-preview Icon Model
nodes.rationale: Chosen because SVG output is XML text, so a text-only reasoning model suffices — avoiding the need for an image generation API for icon creation.

nodes.label: Primary Logo Color Meanings
nodes.rationale: Each color (Blue=trust/stability, Red=energy/urgency, Green=growth, Gold=luxury, Purple=creativity, Orange=friendly, Black=sophistication, White=purity) is tied to industry fit and pairing colors to guide logo palette choice.

nodes.label: Logo Color Accessibility Considerations
nodes.rationale: WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum contrast, avoiding red-green-only indicators, and grayscale testing ensure logos remain legible for colorblind users (~8% of males).

nodes.label: Logo Design Workflow
nodes.rationale: Brief → generate variations → ask user about HTML preview via AskUserQuestion → only if approved, invoke ui-ux-pro-max for a gallery — keeps a human-in-the-loop gate before the heavier gallery-rendering step.

nodes.label: Logo Negative Prompts
nodes.rationale: Excluding photorealistic/3D-render/clipart/watermark terms steers AI generation toward clean, scalable vector-style marks appropriate for logos.

nodes.label: Common Logo Prompt Pitfalls
nodes.rationale: Documents observed failure modes (over-detailed prompts causing complexity, unclear backgrounds, AI struggling with embedded text, wrong aspect ratio, unwanted photorealism) to guide better prompt construction.

nodes.label: 7 Core Logo Types (Wordmark, Lettermark, Pictorial, Abstract, Mascot, Emblem, Combination)
nodes.norm_label: 7 core logo types (wordmark, lettermark, pictorial, abstract, mascot, emblem, combination)

nodes.label: Logo Aesthetic Styles (Minimalist, Vintage, Luxury, Geometric, Organic, Gradient)
nodes.norm_label: logo aesthetic styles (minimalist, vintage, luxury, geometric, organic, gradient)

nodes.label: Logo Scalability Checklist
nodes.rationale: Testing recognizability at 16x16px (favicon size), business-card size, and in single color/black-white ensures logos remain functional across every brand touchpoint, not just full-size renders.

nodes.label: Formula-to-Slide-Type Mapping
nodes.rationale: Maps each slide type (Title/Hook, Problem, Cost/Risk, Solution, Features, Traction, Pricing, CTA) to a primary copy formula and target emotion, so slide content is chosen to elicit a specific emotional beat.

nodes.label: Slide Animation Classes (fade-up, count, scale, stagger)
nodes.norm_label: slide animation classes (fade-up, count, scale, stagger)

nodes.label: Duarte Sparkline Pattern
nodes.rationale: Alternating 'What Is' (pain) and 'What Could Be' (hope) slides, with deliberate pattern breaks at the 1/3 and 2/3 positions, is designed to create engagement peaks and build toward a 'New Bliss' resolution.

nodes.label: Social Photos 8-Step Workflow
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates task management, requirement analysis, ideation with user approval gate, HTML design, screenshot export, visual QA, reporting, and asset organization, spawning parallel subagents for independent per-size/variant work.

nodes.label: Social Photos Screenshot Export Methods
nodes.rationale: Chrome headless CLI, chrome-devtools skill, Playwright, and Puppeteer are offered as alternative export paths, each requiring a 3-5s render delay so web fonts and images fully load before capture, avoiding broken screenshots.
